---
title: "Packages"
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
source("R/status.R")
library(reactable)

status <- read_status()
tab <- status_table(status)
pkgs <- status$packages
```

All `r nrow(tab)` packages, updated `r updated(status)`. Select a package
for its details. Search, sort, or filter using the boxes under the column
headings. Dependencies are counted recursively, excluding base R packages.

```{r}
reactable(
  tab[c("package", "health", "github_version", "cran_status", "cran_checks",
        "universe_checks", "all_dependencies", "open_issues", "open_prs", "last_commit")],
  searchable = TRUE,
  filterable = TRUE,
  pagination = FALSE,
  highlight = TRUE,
  defaultSorted = "package",
  columns = list(
    package = colDef(name = "Package", minWidth = 260, cell = function(value, index) {
      div(
        div(class = "fw-semibold", a(href = paste0("package/", value, ".html"), value)),
        div(class = "small text-body-secondary", tab$title[index])
      )
    }),
    health = colDef(name = "Status", minWidth = 140, cell = function(value) health_badge(value)),
    github_version = colDef(name = "GitHub", minWidth = 100),
    cran_status = colDef(name = "CRAN", minWidth = 110, cell = function(value, index) {
      cran_badge(value, tab$cran_version[index], tab$cran_url[index], pkgs[[index]]$cran$comment)
    }),
    cran_checks = colDef(name = "CRAN checks", minWidth = 110, cell = function(value, index) {
      check_badge(value, tab$cran_checks_url[index])
    }),
    universe_checks = colDef(name = "r-universe", minWidth = 110, cell = function(value, index) {
      universe_badge(tab$universe_build[index], value, tab$universe_url[index])
    }),
    all_dependencies = colDef(name = "Dependencies", minWidth = 110, align = "right", cell = function(value, index) {
      span(title = paste(tab$direct_dependencies[index], "direct"), value)
    }),
    open_issues = colDef(name = "Issues", minWidth = 70, align = "right", cell = function(value, index) {
      if (is.na(value) || value == 0) value else a(href = paste0(tab$github_url[index], "/issues"), value)
    }),
    open_prs = colDef(name = "PRs", minWidth = 60, align = "right", cell = function(value, index) {
      if (is.na(value) || value == 0) value else a(href = paste0(tab$github_url[index], "/pulls"), value)
    }),
    last_commit = colDef(name = "Last commit", minWidth = 110, format = colFormat(date = TRUE))
  ),
  theme = reactableTheme(
    backgroundColor = "transparent",
    color = "inherit",
    borderColor = "var(--bs-border-color)",
    highlightColor = "var(--bs-tertiary-bg)",
    inputStyle = list(backgroundColor = "var(--bs-body-bg)", color = "var(--bs-body-color)")
  )
)
```
